title: Check Dynamic Range
text: Check that signal falls inside range of amplitudes that varies from time step to time step, 3 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Enable assertion} enables or disable check, {Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)} sets the expression to evaluate when assertion, {Stop simulation when assertion fails} sets the whether to stop simulation when check, {Output assertion signal} sets the create output signal and {Select icon type}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: max
ports.summary: Upper bound of dynamic range check scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: min
ports.summary: Lower bound of dynamic range check scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: u
ports.summary: Input signal checked against range scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Enable assertion
params.values: Enable or disable check on (default) | off

params.name: Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)
params.values: Expression to evaluate when assertion fails "" (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Stop simulation when assertion fails
params.values: Whether to stop simulation when check fails on (default) | off
